regime_context: The detector shows a concentrated AI/complex-semiconductor leadership stack (AI Infrastructure, WFE, Memory, Cybersecurity) atop an otherwise narrowing rotation (14 eligible of 49, breadth 0.43) with no one-narrative dominance and a modest 0.555 leader-challenger margin. Cross-sectional rank has no forward edge per the backtest; the only validated leg is the absolute-trend eligibility gate (gate_helps=true), so the note leans on durability/trend-health and states directionals as conditionals, not predictions.
emerging_watch: Watching AI Semiconductors (rank 5, eligible, durability_bar 0.85, 'trend' hurst, not crowded) as a possible handoff recipient if AI Infrastructure breadth fades while AI Semiconductors breadth stays above 0.8 — the watch retires if AI Semiconductors falls out of trend-gate eligibility or AI Infrastructure breadth recovers above 0.87.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: The leader (score 2.253, rank 1) is trend-gate eligible with a 0.73 durability bar and broad participation (breadth 0.875) but is not crowded (crowding_z 0.81), with a fading valuation state. Permitting an overweight continuation lean on the trend-gate plus breadth/cohesion — not on rank — while the fading val_state and mixed hurst keep conviction at medium rather than high.
theses.dissent: val_state='fading' plus mixed hurst suggests leadership is maturing rather than building; a broad AI complex can chop without trend follow-through.

falsifier.text: SMH's AI Infrastructure leg trails the S&P 500 over the check-by window and its breadth reading falls below 0.6 during that span

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Trend-gate eligible with the strongest cohesion signals on the board — durability_bar 0.81, hurst 'trend', and breadth 1.0 — but crowding is high (crowding_z 1.91). Per guardrails this is not a fade and not a buy on the attention flag; it is a modest trend-continuation lean DOWN-SIZED on the crowding caution, so conviction stays low.
theses.dissent: crowding_z near 2 with full breadth marks a fully-owned trend; extension risk means any adverse macro surprise hits the concentrated complex hardest first.

falsifier.text: CIBR breaks below its own 50-day average and its breadth slips under 0.8 within the check-by window

theses.subject: Non-AI Tech & Hardware
theses.thesis: Eligible with the highest durability_bar in the suite (0.92), clean 'trend' hurst, full breadth (1.0) and not crowded (crowding_z 0.96). A strong trend-health profile that is under-ranked (rank 6) relative to its cohesion, which is a reasons-to-hold stretch not a rank-driven call.
theses.dissent: It shares the XLK proxy with several other themes, so a broad tech risk-off would hit it regardless of its own cohesion; the high durability bar may simply reflect the benchmark's own trend.

falsifier.text: XLK's non-AI hardware leg underperforms the broader tech complex by 4% before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
